title: ochthocosmus senensis

It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
